title: Skill test scenarios (tests/scenarios/<skill>/scenarios.yaml)
description: Compatible superset of tests/schemas/skill-scenarios.schema.json in github.com/microsoft/skills. Fields required there are required here; extra fields used by this repository are optional and are stripped by scripts/export-upstream.mjs.

model.description: Used only by optional live evaluations.

environment.description: Default SAP environment for every scenario and acceptance-criteria example in this file. Required for skills whose answers contain ABAP or CDS.
SAP environment for this scenario. Replaces the file-level default entirely.

mock_response.description: Reference answer. Use '<comment> file: <path>' marker lines to split it into files so language validators can check each one.

validators.description: Validators that must run on the reference answer. Defaults to the validators implied by file extensions.

context_files.description: Objects that already exist in the target system and are quoted in the prompt, for example a BAdI interface. Validators parse them together with the answer so references resolve, but only the answer is graded.

negative_responses.description: Known-bad answers. Each must fail this scenario, which proves the checks are not trivially satisfied.

caught_by.description: The kind of check that must reject this answer. 'environment' means a release or database rule from config/sap-environments.yaml.

environment.description: Target SAP system. Values are checked against config/sap-environments.yaml. Deployment does not change validation; product, release, support package, language version, and database do.

product.description: Product id, for example ecc, netweaver, s4hana, s4hana-private-cloud, btp-abap.

release.description: Product release id, for example ehp7 or 2023.

deployment.description: Where SAP runs, for example on-premise, azure-iaas, aws-iaas, gcp-iaas.
